title: On the Distribution of the Length of the Longest Increasing Subsequence of Random Permutations

locations.scope: Uniform permutations; centered n^(1/6) distributional limit and its Painleve-II representation.
Convergence of every fixed positive integer moment, including normalized variance and expectation.

verified_application: The book uses the same uniform-permutation model. First and second moments imply E L_n~2 sqrt(n) and standard deviation Theta(n^(1/6)). Changing u to -u matches the book's Airy sign and leaves u squared unchanged. Continuity of the limit handles strict versus non-strict thresholds.
boundary: The primary theorem statements and exact applicability were checked. The full sixty-page analytic proof and its numerical constants were not independently rederived or computed; these are explicit external dependencies.
